tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnal 'byor bla med kyi phyi dang nang gi yul chen rnams kyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus bshad pa'i yi ge bzhugs// na mo bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ 'dir rnal 'byor bla med kyi phyi nang gi yul chen rnams kyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus bshad par bya'o/ /de la yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rnam gzhag 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud las bshad/ yul chen nyer brgyad kyi rnam gzhag phyag chen thig le las bshad/ sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi rnam gzhag kyai rdor rtsa rgyud las/ bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad kyi rnam gzhag 'khor lo sdom chen las bshad do/ /de ltar mi 'dra ba sna tshogs gsungs pa de dag ni gang zag gi blo'i rim pa'i dbye bsdu tsam yin te/ slob dpon rin po che rtse mo'i zhal snga nas/ de lta bu'i yul stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su bsdu ba de yang yul sum cu rtsa gnyis su bsdu zhing / de yang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir bsdu zhing / de bcu gnyis su/ de yang brgyad du bsdu ba yin pas gang zag gi khams dang bstun te/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /kyai rdor las yul so gnyis su gsungs pa de la/ sgra ji bzhin pa sum cu rtsa gnyis su 'dod pa dang / 'khrugs bsdebs te sa gnyis su 'dod pa gnyis yod pa las/ phyi ma nyid sa skya pa yab sras rnams bzhed de/ sam+bu ṭi las/ gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de bzhin nyer gnas dri ma med/ /zhing ni 'od byed shes par bya/ /nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro ba/ /tshan+dho mngon du gyur pa ste/ /nye ba'i tshan+dho sbyang dka' ba/ /'du ba ring du song ba ste/ /nye ba'i 'du ba mi g.yo ba/ /dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros nyid/ /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i sa rnams la/ /rnal 'byor ma yis kla klo'i skad/ /su la sogs la ci gsungs pa/ /phyi nang nang du bsam par bya/ /zhes thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ming don sbyar nas bstan pa'i/ sa dang po dang gnyis pa la yul chen bzhi bzhi'i rtsa mdud grol dgos par bzhed cing /

gsum pa nas bcu pa'i bar la yul gnyis kyi rtsa mdud grol dgos par bzhed la/ de nas bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa ku mu tir rgyud 'bum pa'i lung drangs pa las/ a bhi dha na las zhes pa'ang mthong / 'thung spyod dpe med ye shes te/ /nye ba'i 'thung spyod ye shes che/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sa lhag ma gnyis po de la yul bzhi bzhi'i rtsa mdud grol dgos par bzhed pa yin no/ /sgra ji bzhin pa sum cu rtsa gnyis su 'dod pa'i lugs ni/ mnga' ris pa'i tshig 'grel/ bla ma rngog pa rnams dang / rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa kha sbyor dri med rnams so/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs kyi yul chen po so gnyis sa rnams la sbyor tshul ni/ u rgyan dang / dza lan+dha ra dang / ko la ki ri dang / ka ma ru ste bzhi sa dang po la sbyor/ de bzhin du ma la wa dang / sin+dhu dang / na ga ra dang / lcags pa'i grangs te bzhi sa gnyis pa la/ mu m+mu ni dang / de wi ko ṭa ste gnyis sa gsum pa la/ ku lu ta dang / ar bu ta gnyis sa bzhi pa la/ ha ri ke la dang / go ta wa ri gnyis sa lnga pa la/ lam+ba ka dang / kañci gnyis sa drug pa la/ byed pa'i grangs dang / gser gling gnyis sa bdun pa la/ koṅka na dang / bin+dha gnyis sa brgyad pa las/ rab song dge 'dun dang / rgya mtsho'i 'gram gnyis sa dgu pa la/ tsa ri tra dang / gzhon nu'i grong khyer gnyis sa bcu pa la/ grong khyer te kha che dang / grong mtha' ste mon yul dang / lañcha mtsho skyes dang / so so raṣ+ṭa dang bzhi sa bcu gcig pa la/ hi ma la ya dang / ko sha la dang / ka liṅka dang / skyed tshal ra ba dang bzhi sa bcu gnyis pa la sbyor bar bzhed do/ /de ltar phyi'i yul chen so gnyis po de dag nang rdo rje lus kyi yul so gnyis dang sbyar na sa dang pos bsdus pa'i yul bzhi ni/ spyi bo dang / spyi gtsug dang / 'tshogs ma dang / smin phrag go /sa gnyis pas bsdus pa bzhi ni/

sna rtse dang / mig dang / rna ba dang / kha'o/ /sa gsum pas bsdus pa gnyis ni/ lkos ka dang / mgrin pa'o/ /sa bzhi pas bsdus pa gnyis ni/ rgal tshigs dang nu ma'o/ /sa lnga pas bsdus pa gnyis ni/ snying kha dang lte ba'o/ /sa drug pas bsdus pa gnyis ni/ gsang gnas kyi nang dang / rtags kyi dbus so/ /sa bdun pas bsdus pa gnyis ni/ rtags kyi rtse dang gzhang kha'o/ /sa brgyad pas bsdus pa gnyis ni/ brla dang / pus mo'o/ /sa dgu pas bsdus pa gnyis ni/ byin pa dang / bol gong ngo / /sa bcu pas bsdus pa gnyis ni/ sor mo dang / mthe bong ngo / /sa bcu gcig pas bsdus pa bzhi ni/ phrag pa dang / rkang mthil dang / snying kha'i phyogs kyi rtsa gnyis so/ /sa bcu gnyis pa bsdus pa bzhi ni/ ltag pa dang / sked pa dang / yang snying kha'i phyogs kyi rtsa gnyis rnams yin par bzhed do/ /'dir smras pa/ bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i rnal 'byor la 'bad pas/ /phyi nang yul chen so gnyis myur bgrod te/ /mi 'phrogs 'bras bu'i dbang la sbyor byed pa'i/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam 'di ngo mtshar/ /deng dus chos grwa dpal ldan sa skya na/ /mtshan nyid theg pa'i grub mtha'i srol 'dzin rgyun/ /cung zad snang mod rgyud sde rin po che'i/ /bka' srol dri med mtshan gyi lhag ma tsam/ /sgra dang snyan ngag la sogs rig gnas gzhan/ /chu 'dzin dwangs pa'i mkha' bzhin dri mas dben/ /bstan pa gsal bar nus pa'i bshes gnyen las/ /bza' btung kho na don gnyer blun po rnams/ /mchog tu 'dzin pa la sogs gnas 'di yi/ /snang tshul gang nas bsams kyang sngon dus kyi/ /rgyal po kri kri zhes bya'i rmi lam du/ /rgan po spyi ther byung ba'i lung bstan bzhin/ /kye ma da ni dus la babs par snang / /kye hud dus ngan 'di la rnam dpyod kyi/ /blo gros rab tu gsal ldan kho bo yis/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa rin chen sgron me che/ /'jig rten khams 'dir gsal bar byed gyur cig

/ces pa 'di yang rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs la yan lag mchog gis reg pa sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi phyi dang nang gi yul chen rnams kyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
